components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action — black fill, white label.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Alternate action — white surface with structural border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #1a1c1c; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #c4c7c7; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eeeeed; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #747878; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary action — no border until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #444748; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #eeeeed; color: #1a1c1c; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #747878; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Inactive filter/category pill — white with border.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #1a1c1c; background: #f9f9f8; border: 1px solid #c4c7c7; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #eeeeed; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #747878; }

components.name: Category Chip Active
components.css: .ds-chip-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #ffffff; background: #000000; border: 1px solid #000000; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-chip-active:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #747878; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Feed header search — pill input with leading icon space.
components.html: ⌕
components.css: .ds-search-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); font-size: 18px; color: #444748; pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px 8px 40px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #1a1c1c; background: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; transition: box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #444748; } .ds-search-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000000; }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Dismissible active filter below search bar.
components.css: .ds-filter-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #1a1c1c; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #c4c7c7; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-filter-pill:active { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-filter-pill-close { font-size: 16px; color: #444748; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Bottom Nav Capsule
components.description: Floating frosted nav — 4 Material Symbol icons; active in red.
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 0 24px 16px; } .ds-bottom-nav-capsule { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; color: #444748; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #ba1a1a; } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 22px; height: 22px; }

narrative.overview: 零元 (Venice Free Finds) uses Google Stitch's Structured Minimalist world: a document-first, monochrome workspace where listings read like a carefully typeset catalog, not a promotional marketplace. Information density, scanability, and calm order outrank decoration. The system prioritizes thin structural borders, generous whitespace, and Inter-driven hierarchy so free items remain the hero.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome-first palette with black primary CTAs and #e5e5e5 structural borders
Inter typography as the sole type family; weight and size carry hierarchy
4px spacing grid; max content width 1200px; 24px gutters
Tonal layering over drop shadows; borders define zones
Mobile-first PWA shell with frosted header/nav overlays on consumer feed surfaces
Radix/shadcn primitives allowed only when restyled to Stitch tokens

rules.name: The One Border Rule
rules.body: All structural divisions use 1px #e5e5e5 (outline-variant). Do not mix border weights or ad-hoc gray hex values across surfaces.

rules.name: The Monochrome Default Rule
rules.body: Screens should read as black, white, and warm gray. Saturated fills appear only on photo overlays (FREE badge) or the two functional accents — never as decorative theme color.

rules.name: The Weight-as-Signal Rule
rules.body: Use 600–700 for headings only. Body stays 400; labels at 500. Never bold body paragraphs for emphasis — use label size or color instead.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards, buttons, and list rows do not carry drop shadows. If depth is needed, step surface tone or add a border.

rules.name: The Hover-Tint Rule
rules.body: Hover and active states change background to surface-container or opacity — never translateY lift on buttons.

dos: Do use @theme tokens from app/globals.css — never default shadcn theme colors.
Do apply .notion-border or border-outline-variant (#e5e5e5) for all structural edges.
Do use Inter scale from tokens: h1/h2/h3, body-md/body-lg, label-md/label-sm.
Do align to the 4px grid (space-xs through space-xl).
Do use black primary buttons for main actions; secondary for alternates.
Do use Material Symbols Outlined for consumer UI icons.
Do left-align text-heavy admin and settings content.
Do extend from Stitch screen prototypes in .planning/google-stitch-ui-design/*_notion_style/code.html when building new surfaces.
donts: Don't use default shadcn rounded-xl/2xl cards, saturated accent palettes, or glassmorphism as a default container treatment.
Don't clone Snag's red theme or floating capsule nav verbatim — interaction yes, visual clone no.
Don't add drop shadows to cards, list rows, or primary buttons.
Don't introduce Lucide or emoji icons on consumer-facing surfaces that already use Material Symbols.
Don't hardcode hex values that drift from @theme tokens without DESIGN.md justification.
Don't invent a new visual language when a Stitch screen prototype exists — extend DESIGN.md instead.
